facts.fact: The ICT Authority's Government Data Centre Standard (ICTA.2.002:2019) says the Kenya Bureau of Standards (KEBS) is the source of information on valid national and international standards and took part in developing the ICTA standards under a memorandum of understanding; the document gives no date for KEBS's creation or its legal basis, and its date is the document's board approval.

systems.system: Government ICT Standards, Data Centre Standard ICTA.2.002:2019
systems.tiers: central government, county governments, constitutional commissions, state corporations

note: ICTA's standard is a government-set technical standard for public bodies, not issued as a national standard by KEBS (class other); ICTA's own compliance certificate to agencies is not from the standards body or an accredited certifier, so no certification fact; ISO 27001/2 is only cited as guidance.
